bullets: Fixed a Freebuff session slot being ended when the launcher replaced the binary with a staged update, so the relaunched CLI now finds the same paid session still waiting.
Added multi-session claim identity to the CLI so each process tags its own seat and reclaims its exact purchased slot on update restart.
Added read-only chat history browsing reached with an H keyboard shortcut, rendering saved transcripts without a composer or admission callbacks.
Added a dedicated superseded session screen shown on a 409 rotated-instance response instead of falling back to the pre-chat landing.
Added an in-place sponsored run contract that delivers advertiser code changes into the open working copy rather than a separate worktree.
Added read-path and git write safety rules for in-place sponsored runs, refusing history-changing git subcommands via a shared refusals list.
Added an in-place version marker to sponsored run offer and accept requests so the CLI declares support for the new style.
Added deferred self-update support to the launcher so downloaded updates stage to a per-process temp dir and only install at session exit.
Added price quote routing so an active CLI session resolves model prices from the desktop purchase store discount.
Added Solar Pro 4 back to the free model picker beside Solar Mini 4, with unsaved picks no longer auto-rewriting to Mini 4.
Added an ad slot hold so a sponsored proposal accepted in chat renders in the dock above the composer and pauses the display ad while it runs.
Added an Undo action and inline delivered-changes view to the docked sponsored proposal card via a new run prop.
Shifted the sponsored compute run window from funded Accept to actual run start, so the one-hour budget no longer drains while a run waits its turn.
Added recovery of a crashed CLI hour from the live PID record so the next start reuses the same unexpired paid hour instead of buying a new one.
Added per-process live session records that delete on release, and expire dead-owner records on startup.
Added trace session and previous run id pointers to agentic ad offers so the ad platform can correlate an offer with the prompting conversation and its last finished run.
Fixed the Freebuff CLI so a SIGTERM from an npm launcher update restart preserves the held session slot for the relaunched binary.
Stopped emitting FreeModeSessionSlowed notifications from the SDK when a free-mode session is paced past its target.
